### Engineering contract

- [ ] This work was developed on a non-`main` branch.
- [ ] I ran `npm run galok:prepare` before the candidate commit.
- [ ] I reviewed `git diff` / `git status --short`.
- [ ] Source changes and deterministic generated artifacts are committed atomically.
- [ ] I ran `npm run galok:preflight` after the complete candidate commit.
- [ ] No temporary/once/preflight/retry/installer workflow was added.
- [ ] No validator/gate was weakened merely to obtain green CI.
- [ ] If Reading text/fonts changed, the complete project-owned fallback stack covers every required glyph.
- [ ] If dependencies changed, `package.json` and `package-lock.json` are synchronized.
